units.text: The source macrotrends.net provides a 2024 midyear population estimate of 10,673,669, not 10,569,709 as claimed for July 1, 2024.

judgement.reason: The passages state the 2024 total population was 10,673,669 and that values are midyear estimates, which directly supports the 2024 midyear estimate and contradicts 10,569,709.

units.text: Official Statistics Sweden registers 10,553,300 people on June 30, 2024, which differs in both date and figure from the July 1, 2024 claim.

judgement.reason: The passage supports the June 30, 2024 registration date and 10,553,300 figure, but it does not mention or contrast any July 1, 2024 claim.

units.text: The claimed population of 10,569,709 does not match any cited source value for the specified date.

judgement.reason: The cited passages list Sweden population values of 10,673,669 for 2024 and 10,553,300 on 30 June 2024; neither equals 10,569,709, so the claimed figure does not match any cited source value.
